card.name: Leading digits of multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that begins or sits inside a multi-digit number, such as the 5 in 50 mg or the 8 in 800 mg. It appears in label text for doses, counts and percentages, and the number continues after the digit.

modes.label: Digit in a dose
modes.description: A digit that starts or sits inside a dose amount before mg.
modes.example: Darunavir tablets <<8>>00 mg taken with ritonav

modes.label: Digit in a count or percent
modes.description: A digit inside a patient count or percentage in study results.
modes.example: Altogether 7<<1>>% of the subjects were vitamin D insufficient

card.plain: It fires on a digit that is only part of a larger number, such as the 8 in 800 mg, where more digits follow.
